title: Song selection on Music › Songs works for Spotify likes
acceptance: With Spotify connected and its Web API answering, the RF-151 checkboxes, 15-song cap, selection bar and "Create a class" sheet work for Spotify likes as they do for Apple Music and SoundCloud, at 1440 and 390 wide.
Selection clears on switching to or from Spotify, and a component or e2e test covers the Spotify likes list with the mock provider.
nextAction: Split from RF-151 on 2026-10-30 (#667 final review) so RF-151 does not wait on Spotify. No parent on purpose: an open child would block RF-151 from Done. Start after RF-92 and RF-151 are Done. Agent-created: Backlog until the owner sets Ready.

evidence.summary: Final review of #667, item 1: RF-151 depending on RF-92 would block its Apple and SoundCloud work.

On production 67496ab (RF-151 pick mode), the Neo's desktop Chrome check in the owner's signed-in browser listed Spotify liked songs on Music › Songs and selection worked on them; nothing was saved. So Spotify likes already reach the pick-mode list; whether this record still needs work, and whether it still waits on RF-92, is for the owner to decide.
